# `core/compression/MeshCompression.js`

> **Source:** `engine/core/compression/MeshCompression.js`

MeshCompression.js - Mesh Data Compression Compresses mesh data using: - Position quantization (Float32 → Int16): 50% reduction - Normal octahedral encoding: 66% reduction - UV half-float encoding: 50% reduction - Index VLInt encoding: 30-50% reduction Typical compression: 70-90% reduction in mesh size

## Functions

### `compressMesh(mesh, options = {})`

Compress mesh data

**Parameters:**

- `mesh` *(Object)* — { positions, normals, uvs, indices, bounds }
- `options` *(Object)* — { lossless: boolean } - Set lossless=true for zero quality loss

**Returns:** Compressed mesh data

### `decompressMesh(compressed)`

Decompress mesh data

**Parameters:**

- `compressed` *(Object)* — Compressed mesh data

**Returns:** Decompressed mesh { positions, normals, uvs, indices }

### `compressMeshBatch(meshes)`

Compress multiple meshes and combine into single buffer Useful for static scene geometry

### `decompressMeshBatch(compressedBatch)`

Decompress batch of meshes

### `compressMeshForStreaming(mesh, lodLevels = [1.0, 0.5, 0.25])`

Compress mesh for streaming (progressive loading) Returns base LOD + detail layers
